architecture_selection.rule: architecture changes require concordant AP and pixel-IoU gains on both site-held folds; no sealed-test access

crossfit.calibration_rule: for outer fold k, calibrator and operating threshold fit OOF predictions from the other four folds only
crossfit.final_rule: after freezing, fit the deployable calibrator on all OOF predictions and ensemble all five fold models
crossfit.fit_rule: model k fits every development site except fold k
crossfit.oof_rule: each development site is predicted only by the model that excluded it

paper_test.access: one shot only after model/checkpoint/calibration/threshold/postprocessing hashes are frozen
paper_test.comparison: paper Table S5/S6 and stronger archived per-scene reconstruction

promotion_gate.pixel: cross-fitted positive-pixel IoU higher than the released checkpoint
promotion_gate.scene: cross-fitted AP higher, recall higher, and FPR no worse than the released checkpoint under identical rows
promotion_gate.sensors: report Sentinel-2 and Landsat strata; neither sensor may show a material regression
promotion_gate.uncertainty: paired site-block bootstrap 95% interval for AP and IoU deltas must be above zero
